_Documentation_: _this will not affect the simulation: don't edit it_
_Required_:  the sd_cases array must be present with []

sd_cases.name: young
sd_cases._Start and End day_: Required: day social distancing begins and ends
sd_cases._Comply_: Not everyone compies: percentage of people who comply
sd_cases._contact_delta_: reduces contact factor, which reduces number of contacts
sd_cases._by_: squashing existing contact factors between 2 values
sd_cases._touch_delta_: reduces probability of significant contact touch
sd_cases._continued_: must be in 0.0, 1.0 and first < second
sd_cases._values_: an empty array includes all age groups in the case.
sd_cases._specific age groups_: use Age0_19, Age20_39, Age40_59, Age60_79, Age80_up in double quotes to include specific age groups only
